content: 1. Fostemsavir inhibits the OATP1B1/3 transporter. If possible, avoid coadministration or adjust the dose of OATP1B1/3 substrates when used with fostemsavir. 2. Both ribociclib and fostemsavir increase the QTc interval. Exercise caution and monitor patients closely. QTc prolongation has been reported with doses of fostemsavir exceeding the recommended levels. 3. Rilpivirine and fostemsavir both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients. QTc prolongation has been observed with higher-than-recommended doses of fostemsavir. 4. Fostemsavir increases the levels or effects of riociguat. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 5. Avoid coadministration or adjust the dose of OATP1B1/3 or BCRP substrates when used with fostemsavir, if possible.
